profile.headline: Web Developer + Communicator
profile.summary: I have discovered a sweet spot in development that combines my ability to communicate and my love for generating ideas and solutions so that I can make an impact for others.  I want to be a part of molding the way we use, design and focus on technologies in the interest of a better future for people and our planet.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Skills: WordPress · Shopify · React.js · Next.js · JavaScript · Astro JS · HubSpot · Figma · Asana · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Tailwind CSS · GitHub

positions.title: Tech Director of Partner Programs/Web Developer
positions.description:
Designing and Developing processes for innovative data privacy solutions.
Development and management of Partner Programs.

positions.title: Administrative Lead
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Senior Hairstylist
positions.description: While working as an employee at Cake Hair Salon, with a team of 6-8 other stylists in a fast paced environment I brought new clients in and maintained over a 90% retention rate within my first year.  The operations at this salon were very different from my previous salon operations. I quickly adapted to using the new software and understanding the language, workflow/processes of the client experience at Cake Hair Salon.  Here I was able to expand my knowledge and education at many levels while also helping to mentor and coach stylists with lesser experience than myself.

positions.title: Hairstylist
positions.description: For 10 years I built and sustained a client base of over 200 people from all walks of life as an independent contractor operating under an LLC.  Fielding my own calls and appointments while maintaining a very organized and efficient schedule was practiced daily.  I am highly skilled in the ability to help clients make decisions about what outcome would be most suitable and maintainable to their daily lives and budgets.  Being a very effective communicator on the phone and in person was vital to my success.  Making relationships and creating rapport is something I truly enjoy!

positions.title: Hairstylist
positions.description: Worked as a commission based stylist until developing my own clientele. Built rapport and maintained relationships with various types of customers, including local clients, as well as illustrious Vail tourists. Moved into booth rent with the company once I had established a solid client base and kept up with my books, scheduling, product ordering, taxes, etc.
